title: Sprint planning reads every interval or delay an item's notes name against the latency figures its goal allows
goal: the sprint skill's plan step 6 tells the planner to check each interval, wake or poll period an item's notes name against each latency figure of its goal, so a notes value that cannot meet the goal is changed or gated before the start gate

run:
import re,sys
t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
s=t.split('## plan',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0]
step=[p for p in re.split(r'\n(?=\d+\. )',s) if p.startswith('6. ')]
sys.exit(0 if step and re.search('latenc',step[0],re.I) else 1)
